card.name: Punctuation in textbook citations
card.fires_on: Punctuation or small linking words inside reference-list citations, just before an editor name or a book edition, such as the colon after "In" or the period after "eds".

modes.label: Citation punctuation
modes.description: Colon, comma or period in a textbook reference, right before editor names or the book title or edition.

modes.label: Other linking spots
modes.description: Scattered small words in label text, like "as" after "such" or a space after "younger than".
